sermon.title: Guest Speaker Q&A from session 3
sermon.speaker: Guest speaker (Freedom House ministry; name not stated)
sermon.summary: A guest speaker answers when to stop helping people: be led by the Spirit, get your own house in order, and watch for fruit—sapsuckers drain fruit-bearing trees. Keep reaching out, even into bars.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

chunks.section_question: When do you stop helping someone in need?
chunks.short_answer: Be led by the Holy Spirit—get your own house in order first; he and Tony have long experience.
chunks.text:
I thought this is a good question uh especially for you guys. How do you know when to stop helping someone in need or how it was crossed out here? But I think it’s a good question. How do you know when to stop helping the people in need? When to stop help? Go ahead. That’s kind of a tricky question. Um because I think that help just looks different throughout all seasons. And so sometimes we have to pull back from someone that’s not growing, that’s rejecting the Lord. We realize that we’re enabling, but we still help by prayer. Like we remember to call their name out before the Lord.

So um in everything though, you have to be led by the Holy Spirit. Um Tony and I have a lot of experience in pouring ourselves out and pouring ourselves out in situations that God never told us to pour ourselves out in. Um it is one of the most difficult things that I’ve experienced in my life when you pour yourself out and pour yourself out and then there’s rejection. And one of my prayers to the Lord is I pray all the time, Lord, please help me love each person that you set before me like it’s the first time I’ve ever loved in your name. Because it’s so easy to get weary and to get tired, especially trying to find the balance of being led by the Holy Spirit, doing the right thing.

I don’t think any one person can tell you how to do that. That’s why the Bible says you have to have your house in order first. When you get your house in order with the Lord, you have a relationship with him. You’re already obeying him. You’re already doing what he said. You can hear the voice of the Lord. And you know when the Lord’s leading to do you leading you to do something. Does that make sense? Amen. Well, it like she said, we have found ourselves in a lot of positions because we just want to help everybody and we want to want to do everything for everybody we can and all those things, but you know, it’s hard for me to give a a a straight answer on this, but I can tell you this, like there’s not one answer. And the reason being is because there’s so many different factors that we see in the lives of people when they come to that place of making peace with rebellion.

Now think about that statement. When you’re at a place that you’re making peace with rebellion to God, we’re come to the place that I have to imply the scripture that says, “Go ahead and hand them over to Satan now so that they can be saved. It says it. It says it. And so we get to this place in in in in loving people and you realize that you’re not going any farther with this person because they’re rejecting what you’re giving them. And you have to withdraw and let them go back where they came from. Mama Lynn calls it going back around the mountain. Sometimes you have to turn them loose and let them go do what it is they want to do and find out that that’s they’re not who they think they are. And then they usually come back going, “Okay, you were right. Please help me again.” And so hopefully that answer,.

chunks.text:
Okay, in my life, in my experience, this is how I would say it. A tree can have sap suckers. Sapsuckers do not produce fruit. Sap suckers take away from the fruit producing tree. And when you spend enough time with people and there’s no fruit, they’re just consuming your time, you got to cut them off because it’s going to affect you, the tree that’s really producing fruit. All right.
